image_prompt: A short-statured middle-aged Prussian king from the 1720s, notably diminutive in height with a stern, austere countenance. His face is severe and pinched, with hard eyes that convey strictness and parsimony, thin disapproving lips, and a rigid jawline. He has a powdered wig in the formal 18th century Prussian style, white and precisely arranged. His military uniform is that of a Prussian monarch: a dark blue wool coat with red facings and brass buttons, white waistcoat beneath, and a black tricorn hat held under his arm. The uniform is well-made but notably plain and unadorned for royalty, reflecting his parsimonious nature. White breeches and black leather boots complete the outfit. His posture is rigidly upright, compensating for his short stature, with a military bearing that emphasizes regimentation and discipline. His complexion is pale, typical of Northern European nobility, with a hard, unforgiving expression etched into every feature. The overall appearance conveys authority through severity rather than grandeur.
